# 动作图片来源

- 81 张动作图来自 [yuhonas/free-exercise-db](https://github.com/yuhonas/free-exercise-db)，该项目以 [Unlicense](https://github.com/yuhonas/free-exercise-db/blob/main/LICENSE) 发布。本地图片已统一缩放到 240 × 160、JPEG 质量 75。
- `Bird_Dog.jpg` 与 `Burpee.jpg` 为 2026-08-22 使用 OpenAI 内置图片生成工具制作的动作示意图，随后同样缩放到 240 × 160。

## 生成提示词

### Bird_Dog.jpg

```text
Use case: scientific-educational
Asset type: low-resolution exercise-library thumbnail for a Chinese fitness website
Primary request: a clear instructional image of the bird dog exercise
Scene/backdrop: minimal pale warm-gray gym studio background
Subject: one healthy adult athlete on hands and knees, extending one arm straight forward and the opposite leg straight backward, neutral spine, full body visible
Style/medium: clean realistic fitness instruction photography with slightly simplified, crisp shapes
Composition/framing: landscape 3:2, centered full body, side three-quarter view, generous margins so no limbs are cropped
Lighting/mood: soft even studio light, calm and instructional
Color palette: charcoal athletic clothing with a subtle muted green accent
Constraints: anatomically plausible pose; exactly one person; no labels; no text; no arrows; no logos; no watermark; no medical or rehabilitation context
Avoid: dramatic bodybuilding look, cropped hands or feet, duplicated limbs, busy gym equipment
```
